sources.title: XAU/USD Forecast — AI Signal: SELL at $4138.71
sources.snippet: What data feeds the forecast? Polygon.io for real-time XAU/USD prices, TwelveData for technicals, FRED for macro indicators (DXY, yields, VIX), CFTC for weekly COT positioning, and Benzinga for news.
